evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To test this structure-aware social reasoning, we introduce LongSocialBench, a benchmark of 1,462 verified human-authored multiple-choice items drawn from 94 complete Hacker News, Stack Exchange, and Reddit r/ChangeMyView episodes, with a median length of approximately 73K tokens.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Each item pairs a complete serialized discussion and reply structure with a four-option question, requiring models to recover structured social evidence.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 18 models and 29 evaluation settings, current long-context workflows remain far below human performance.
